req.title: Delete player
req.statement: The system shall delete the specified player and respond with HTTP 204 when DELETE /players/{playerId} is called.

doc.reasoning: The test suite is designed to validate the DELETE /players/{playerId} endpoint, ensuring it correctly deletes a player and handles various edge cases. The tests cover positive, negative, and boundary scenarios to ensure robustness against common mutations.

tests.name: test_delete_player_success
preconditions: A player with squad number 10 exists in the database.
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

# Precondition: Create a player with squad number 10
player_data = {
    "firstName": "John",
    "lastName": "Doe",
    "squadNumber": 10,
    "position": "Forward"
}
client.post("/players/", json=player_data)

# Action: Delete the player
response = client.delete("/players/squadnumber/10")

# Expected: Status code 204
assert response.status_code == 204

tests.name: test_delete_player_not_found
preconditions: No player with squad number 999 exists in the database.
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

# Action: Attempt to delete a non-existent player
response = client.delete("/players/squadnumber/999")

# Expected: Status code 404
assert response.status_code == 404

tests.name: test_delete_player_boundary
preconditions: A player with squad number 1 exists in the database.
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

# Precondition: Create a player with squad number 1
player_data = {
